json_monolithic_value.blocker: JsonParser::parse_with_visitor associated fn not emitted for JSON grammar
json_monolithic_value.root_cause: crates/core/src/backend/rust/emitter/grammar.rs:718 gates parse_with_visitor emission on `!has_w4_classified(ir)`. W4 detector widening (W4-fix-rest commits 569c17e4 / ce2fd9f6) admitted JSON's `pair` rule as Flat-shape and `value` rule as Wrap-shape. has_w4_classified consequently returns true for JSON, disabling visitor-path emission. The shape substrate (__shape_support_JsonParser, parse_object_JsonParser_object, parse_wrap_JsonParser_value, etc.) emits correctly; only the top-level parse_with_visitor entry is gated off.
json_monolithic_value.impact: The W3.2 bench-fix visitor-path that landed with c1e86ab3 beat sonic-rs on every JSON entry at W3 close (ratios 0.98-1.00× prototype, 0.89-1.03× sonic). W5.2's per-Ref refactor preserved the has_w4_classified gate intentionally (commented 'a follow-on wave'); W6 surfaces that the gate's coarseness now blocks JSON's own visitor admission.
json_monolithic_value.remediation: Narrow has_w4_classified to gate only grammars where W4 shapes ACTUALLY REQUIRE W4-visitor traits the dispatcher doesn't bound (e.g. PrattVisitor). JSON's Flat / Wrap classifications route through standard shape visitor traits already in the dispatcher's bound set (ObjectVisitor + ArrayVisitor + StringVisitor + NumberVisitor + KeywordVisitor). Deferred to AW-VI / successor tranche per the no-deferrals-within-tranche invariant; AW-V's W6 gate is measured honestly against what compiles.

summary.honest_assessment: AW-V.W6 substrate landed verifiably across every wave: bbnf-tape-codegen + bbnf-simd-scan::emit (W1), JSON prototype beating sonic-rs (W2.1), shape classifier + per-shape emitters for 12 shape categories (W3+W4), BBNF GRAMMAR_PROFILE wire-contract fix + per-Ref dispatcher refactor (W5). The W6 throughput gate — every parse entry exceeds post-AU — MISSES (0/17); JSON improves +65-73% over AW-IV but stays ~25% of post-AU RD baseline because the emitter-produced JSON parser on the monolithic tape-path retains the full structural tape buildup. The W3 visitor-path bench that matched the prototype at W3 close DOES NOT COMPILE at W6 close because W4's detector widening inadvertently classified JSON rules as W4 shapes, and the has_w4_classified gate (introduced to protect the dispatcher's narrow W3 trait bounds) consequently disables visitor-path emission on JSON. CSS / Sheets / BBNF parse() continues through walker because has_shape_dispatcher_entrypoint Criterion 2 admits the substrate but the W4 activation gap persists at the dispatcher level. The architectural substrate IS viable (prototype beats sonic; per-shape emitters compile for every grammar; detector coverage 86% CSS / 80% Sheets / 67% BBNF); the compounding activation — parse() routing through shape dispatcher for non-JSON grammars + visitor emission admitted for W4-classified JSON — carries forward to AW-VI.
